activity_summary: The loaf was a penny and a full thumb short of the notch. The back was the same back you took to church. You ate the soft of it and gave the table no story. You were not writing at her board.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate on the quiet side, and brought no page to the table.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Measured the thumb, and refused a house fed on hints.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named the left side, and put the rest under the cloth.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Not the dinner. Left where he was.

entities.name: a penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in A penny, and a thumb

facets.activity: Ate the soft of the penny loaf with Mistress Ansell and Alse

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: A full thumb short, and the price is still a penny.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: A penny is the whole of the business on this board.
